messages:
priya: Postmortem follow-up: recurring pager for cache-populate failures keeps waking oncall. Wanted to align on noise mitigation without masking real incidents.

evan: saw ~85 pages in last 7 days, mostly around 03:00 when background jobs run. Many were duplicates across instances.

jordan: idea: add a job-window suppression (02:45-03:30 UTC) that mutes P2s for cache-populate.* alerts, but keep a realtime SLO override if error_rate > 0.4% over 1m.

nate: add dedupe key = job_id + shard to collapse multi-instance fanout. set dedupe window 15m. also tag alerts with "launch_batch" label so we can filter dashboard counts.

priya: good. prefer job-window over global quiet-hours so we don't accidentally mute unrelated stuff. also want a daily digest to owners instead of pages for suppressed events.

evan: i can add the digest -> send aggregated count + top fingerprints at 06:00 UTC to #cache-owners. keeps visibility.

ops-bot: runbook updated by @priya: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cache-populate-failures

jordan: small config sketch: ```yaml
alert: CachePopulateFailure
expr: sum(rate(cache_populate_errors[1m])) by (job_id, shard)
for: 1m
labels:
  severity: p2
  dedupe_key: "{{job_id}}:{{shard}}:{{error_type}}"
annotations:
  summary: "Cache populate failures ({{job_id}}/{{shard}})"
```
then combine with suppression: `if current_time in window && severity==p2 -> notify=digest`

nate: timeline: PR by Tue EOD, staging deploy Wed, 48h monitor, prod Friday if green. Owners: evan (PR + digest), priya (runbook + exceptions), jordan (merge + prod gating).

priya: i'll add acceptance tests that replay the 03:00 job to verify dedupe and digest behavior.

evan: i'll wire the digest to Slack and include a quick-link to replay logs.

jordan: note: for prod-critical shards we set dedupe window to 5m and escalate to P1 if error persists > 10m.

ops-bot: @channel On-call this week: Fri -> @jordan, Sat -> @nate, Sun -> @priya.

nate: quick question: should the digest include a sample error fingerprint? helpful for triage.

priya: yes include top 3 fingerprints and last-success timestamps. also include count delta vs baseline.

evan: action items recap: evan -> PR + digest integration; priya -> runbook tests + exceptions list; jordan -> prod gating rules; nate -> dedupe code & tests. Target: PR merged Tue EOD.

priya: thanks all. let's aim to cut pages by ~80% while keeping signal. reconvene Monday 11am to review staging metrics. :thumbsup:

jordan: ACK, will add calendar invite.```
